title: Make a course by hand
summary: Create a course and fill in its lessons yourself.
focus: The course editor: units, lessons, saving and downloading
content:
## Create it

On the course list, press **Create a course**. The app makes a starter course called *Untitled course* with one example lesson. A **Generate the course** dialog opens. Close it to write the course yourself.

Click the title at the top of the page to rename the course.

## The lesson table

The page lists your lessons as a table. The first row holds the course settings.

- **+** on a unit adds a lesson to it.
- Click a name to rename it.
- Drag a row by its grip to move it.
- **✕** deletes a row.
- **⧉** duplicates a lesson.
- **+ Add unit** adds a unit at the end.

The **▸** on a row opens the lesson. A lesson has text split into cards by `##` headings, words, and questions. To fill it in with forms, open the gear on the course settings row and turn the **JSON** switch off.

## Saving

There is no Save button. Every change saves as you make it. The circle by the title is a green check when all is saved.

**Undo** and **Redo** under the table take back and restore your last edits. **Download all files** at the bottom saves the whole course as one file.

vocabulary.meaning: a group of lessons inside a course
one part of a lesson, started by a ## heading
takes back your last stretch of editing
saves the whole course as one JSON file

quiz.prompt: Which button starts a new course of your own?
quiz.explanation: Create a course on the course list makes a starter course.
hints: Its name says what it does.

quiz.prompt: You must press a Save button to keep your changes.
quiz.explanation: There is no Save button. Every change saves as you make it.
hints: Look for the circle by the title.

quiz.prompt: What name does a new course start with?
quiz.explanation: The starter course is called Untitled course. Click the title to rename it.

quiz.prompt: What does the ⧉ button on a lesson row do?
quiz.explanation: The copy lands right below, ready to edit.

quiz.prompt: What does Download all files give you?
options: The whole course as one file
quiz.correct_answer: The whole course as one file
quiz.explanation: It exports every file of the course as one JSON file.
hints: The word all is the clue.

sorts.title: What does it do?

items.text: Dragging a row by its grip

sorts.why: Plus and copy make new rows. The cross removes. Dragging and clicking a name change order and names.
